question: Which material types of vessels are enumerated in this teaching?
premises: Vessels made of clay are named
Vessels derived from tortoise are named
Vessels of bell-metal and copper metal are named
inference: The teaching enumerates vessels made of clay, tortoise, bell-metal, and copper.
plain_english: O goddess, those made of clay, born of tortoise, made of bell-metal, and born of copper metal.
